bio: Matthew Dunlap (born November 26, 1964) is an American politician from Maine who has served as the Maine state auditor since November 2022. He previously held the same position from January to October 2021. A member of the Democratic Party, Dunlap was secretary of state of Maine from January 7, 2013, to January 4, 2021, and previously from 2005 to 2011.
offices: Member of the Maine House of Representatives (1996–2005)
